figures.alt: Photo of a green frog on a lily pad with a tadpole swimming in the water below.
figures.caption: A frog begins as a tadpole. Its life cycle has stages.

figures.alt: Photo of two bean plants in clear cups. The left one is short with a thick stem and wide leaves. The right one is taller with a thin stem and small leaves.
figures.caption: The same kind of bean looks different in sun and in shade. Environment changes how a trait shows up.

figures.alt: Grouped bar graph of 10 offspring seeds per parent. Yellow parent: 8 yellow, 2 green. Green parent: 9 green, 1 yellow. Spotted parent: 6 spotted, 4 yellow.
figures.caption: Each parent bean made 10 offspring seeds. Most look like the parent, but not all.

figures.alt: Bar graph, Bean height after two weeks. Sun plant 18 cm, Shade plant 22 cm.
figures.caption: After two weeks the shade plant was taller (22 cm) than the sun plant (18 cm), but thin, pale and with small leaves. The sun plant had a thick green stem and wide leaves.
